channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Vince Carter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Vince Carter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Madison Square Garden on Vince Carter, Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, New Jersey
item.description:
“… I grew up, obviously, in Jersey, obviously it was so much easier for me to get New Jersey Nets tickets and see Kenyon Martin, Vince Carter, Jason Kidd, but my family has always had such respect and love for the Knicks and my father having ties to the Knicks, it was kind of guaranteed I was going to fall into this world of being a Knicks fan growing up.”

Madison Square Garden on Vince Carter, Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, New Jersey, May 30, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Egor Demin on Vince Carter
item.description:
Egor Demin, as he does often, took notes while speaking with the Hall of Famer, who also happens to be the favorite player of Dëmin’s father, Vladimir, who played basketball professionally in Russia.

“When my dad saw the video of me talking to [Vince Carter], he was crying [and said], ‘Man, that guy changed the game,’”

Egor Demin on Vince Carter, Nov 19, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: James Dolan on Vince Carter, Grant Hill
item.description:
James Dolan:

“Yeah, a long time ago. I’ve got to even remember… he ended up playing for the Nets. Oh, shoot. Great scorer. It wasn’t Grant Hill. It was a guy out of Toronto—Vince Carter. Vince Carter is a great example. We were going to do the trade. But the medical team came back and told us he had a 90% severed Achilles tendon. They said it would never hold up.”

James Dolan on Vince Carter, Grant Hill, Mar 13, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Vince Carter
item.description:
Masai Ujiri:

“The Vince Carter effect is real. It doesn’t matter what happened. Time heals… We’re very very proud of the path he set for us.”

Masai Ujiri on Vince Carter, Sep 27, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Vince Carter, Dwyane Wade, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, James Harden
item.description:
Gilbert Arenas:

“If we really want to have this discussion about Jordan’s competition, just look at the top five shooting guards in history. He didn’t play against any of them in their prime. Kobe’s number two, but he had a young Kobe in ’98. Then you have Allen Iverson, Dwyane Wade, James Harden, Tracy McGrady, Vince Carter—Jordan didn’t face these guys. History is showing you who’s who now because time has gone by.”

Gilbert Arenas on Vince Carter, Dwyane Wade, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, James Harden, Aug 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Vince Carter, Jamal Crawford, Steve Smith
item.description:
“I hope the NBA stays with TNT, but for me personally, I wanted you guys to hear it from me ...I wanted to tell my NBATV and TNT family that I'm not going to another network, but I'm going to pass the baton to either Jamal Crawford or Vince Carter or you Steve (Smith),”

Charles Barkley on Vince Carter, Jamal Crawford, Steve Smith, Jun 15, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Vince Carter
item.description:
More Anthony Edwards:

“It gives me chills, man. Because like, I always dreamed of dunking on somebody like that and watching Vince Carter jump over somebody or like watching T-Mac. I always dreamed of dunking on somebody like that and that was like my favorite one of all time.”

Anthony Edwards on Vince Carter, Mar 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Shane Larkin on Vince Carter, Dirk Nowitzki, Shawn Marion
item.description:
“I told him my biggest regret was that when I went to the NBA I kind of thought like, 'Oh, now I'm playing with Vince Carter, Shawn Marion, Dirk Nowitzki, like, I got to get them the ball and get out of the way. Like they're the All-Stars, they're the superstars, they've been in the league for 12, 15 or 20 years and I'm just this 20-year-old rookie coming out first, second, and third year playing with guys in Dallas, New York, and Brooklyn.' And I never really felt like I took advantage of the opportunity to just be me, and that's what I told him he doesn't want to feel,”

Shane Larkin on Vince Carter, Dirk Nowitzki, Shawn Marion, Jul 20, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Vince Carter
item.description:
“Vince Carter is the first player I watched and idolized as a kid… it’s pretty cool to pass him and I’m glad I’m doing it in a Nets uniform,”

Kevin Durant on Vince Carter, Nov 1, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Terrence Ross on Vince Carter, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Terrence Ross on if no Kawhi Leonard motivated the Magic:

“We have a job to do. It didn't matter if they had Vince Carter, Kawhi, DeMar. We had to go and do what we had to do.”

Terrence Ross on Vince Carter, Kawhi Leonard, Feb 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Vince Carter
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Vince Carter:

“He’s one of the most amazing athletes I’ve ever seen. The thing about Vince is he can play virtually any sport. I’ve seen him play center field in (Dirk's) Heroes Game and hit home runs and run down fly balls and look like Paul Blair out there.”

Rick Carlisle on Vince Carter, Oct 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Nick DePaula on Vince Carter
item.description:
Nick DePaula on Puma:

“Behind the scenes, this has been in the works for [about] a year to a year-and-a-half, just from the standpoint of identifying players from the college ranks as well as physically building a shoe that guys will believe in and want to play in. When you look back at 1998, which is when they last launched a basketball shoe, they’d done a 10-year deal with Vince Carter at that time and it was for $50 million, which was a huge offer. But the sides parted ways after only two years and VC was the only guy they had signed, so they were pretty much stuck after he left.”

Nick DePaula on Vince Carter, Jul 10, 2018. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Michael Grange on Vince Carter
item.description:
Michael Grange on Vince Carter possibility returning to Toronto:

“I wrote the other day that Vince Carter is someone who they’ve discussed internally and I think that’s cool for a number of reasons. But if you look at Vince’s numbers, as long as he has three days off [between games], he’s really good... Bringing back Vince could be something that happens next year just as more of a ceremonial thing, where they sign him to a one-day contract and he retires in a Raptors jersey. I think that’s more likely what ends up happening.”

Michael Grange on Vince Carter, Feb 14, 2018. Source: audioBoom.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Vince Carter
item.description:
“They got a lot bringing a guy like Vince Carter in with his leadership. He can still play. It’s clear every time you watch him. He’s still a good basketball player on the floor, not just an experience guy. He still gets it done.”

Frank Vogel on Vince Carter, Jan 24, 2018. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Garrett Temple on Vince Carter, Buddy Hield
item.description:
said guard Garrett Temple, who is entering his eighth season.

“If I was a Buddy Hield, I’d be asking Vince Carter question after question,”

Garrett Temple on Vince Carter, Buddy Hield, Sep 26, 2017. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Jason Richardson on Vince Carter, Michael Jordan, Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Jason Richardson on being one of the great dunkers in All-Star history:

“I think my name is in there. I did some dunks that few had ever seen, I kind of brought the dunk contest back. I feel that because of the dunks I did and what I brought to the dunk contest, I'll probably be remembered with those guys like Michael Jordan and Vince Carter, you know even Aaron Gordon and those guys that are being considered great dunkers also.”

Jason Richardson on Vince Carter, Michael Jordan, Aaron Gordon, Oct 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @BarriHoopsHype.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Vince Carter
item.description:
Ian Begley:Matt Barnes on if he saw what happened during Vince Carter's run-in with the fan:

“I try to stay out of situations that might get me fined.”

Matt Barnes on Vince Carter, Feb 6, 2016. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Alvin Williams on Vince Carter, Tracy McGrady
item.description:
“We had a mega-star in Vince Carter. We had a star in the making in Tracy McGrady,”

Alvin Williams on Vince Carter, Tracy McGrady, Dec 5, 2015. Source: cbc.ca.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Vince Carter
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Dirk on ASG dunk celebration:

“That was definitely a shoutout to @Vince Carter, probably the greatest dunker we ever had in this game.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Vince Carter, Feb 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.
